{{Quote|The Imperial Colonization Board regrets to announce that the Kammia colony, Drynn system, has succumbed to a mysterious virus. At this time, there are no reports of survivors.|[[Imperial HoloVision]] news release|<ref name="TBSB" />}}
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] '''raided''' a number of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] outpost [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] along the edge of civilized [[Realspace/Legends|space]], enslaving their [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists through a process known as "[[entechment]]," as part of a deal struck with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who craved the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]' technology. One such colony world was [[Kammia]], which the [[Ssi-ruu]]k raided in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].

==Prelude==
When [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] made contact with the alien invaders called the [[Ssi-ruu]]k, he made a deal with them: In exchange for their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] technology, the invaders were allowed to attack smaller colonies at the edge of [[Wild Space/Legends|colonized space]]. The Kammia colony in the [[Drynn system]] was one of these.<ref name="TBSB" />

==The raid==
The Ssi-ruuk raided the planet Kammia.<ref name="Geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Aftermath==
Since the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] wanted to keep the presence of the Ssi-ruuk a secret, the [[Imperial Colonization Board]] released a cover-up story at 37:4:21, which was published through [[Imperial HoloVision]] and [[Galaxywide NewsNets]]. According to it, the entire colony succumbed to a "mysterious" virus, that evolved from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] grain brought to Kammia by the colonists.<ref name="TBSB" />

Nonetheless, rumors escaped about this and other incidents and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] whispered about them in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].<ref name="Geo" />
